plan.major: Music Education - Keyboard Vocal Music Option for Teacher Licensure
plan.notes: Term-by-term sequence transcribed verbatim from the official 2025-2026 Arkansas Tech University Catalog, 'Music Education - Keyboard Vocal Music Option for Teacher Licensure, Bachelor of Music Education' curriculum (pp. 193-196), a genuine institution-published semester sequence. To meet the requirements for this baccalaureate degree, the student must complete 122-126 semester hours, including: 14 hours of applied music and successful completion of the Applied Competency and Keyboard Proficiency Exams; 7 hours in major ensembles (band or choir); 16 hours in music theory and ear training; and 9 hours of music history. The total-hour range reflects four instrument-method courses printed as 0-1 hours (MUS 3481, MUS 3401, MUS 3421, MUS 3431): each is seeded at the catalog minimum (0 hours) with the printed range documented in choice_note, so total_credits is the catalog minimum 122. An audition, demonstrating acceptable musical preparation, is required prior to enrollment as a major in music. For licensure, students must pass the Praxis II music specialty and Principles of Learning and Teaching exam. See the Department of Music (p. 182) and the College of Education and Health (p. 248) pages for additional requirements. Catalog footnote 1: see appropriate alternatives or substitutions in General Education Requirements (p. 75). Catalog footnote 2: see course descriptions for the appropriate applied music course number. Catalog footnote 3: class piano or applied piano must be taken each semester until successful completion of Piano Exit Exam. Catalog footnote 4: Applied Competency is required for enrollment in two-credit hour and three-credit hour upper-level applied study and for the completion of all music degrees. Catalog footnote 5: prerequisite: successful completion of Piano Exit Exam. Catalog footnote 6: prerequisite: admission to Stage II. Catalog footnote 7: see admission policy and procedure. Catalog footnote 8: for licensure, students must pass the Praxis II music specialty and Principles of Learning and Teaching exam. Catalog footnote 9: concurrent enrollment in a major ensemble is required to be eligible to enroll in applied study; only one credit per semester may be used to fulfill the major ensemble requirement. Catalog footnote 10: SEED 4553 and SPED 4052 are part of the Residency A requirements in the completion of a yearlong residency experience per DESE requirements, including a minimum 270-hour field-experience component in the Residency A semester. Zero-credit items (MUS 1000/MUS 3000 Recital Attendance, MUS 1440 Piano Proficiency, MUS 2000 Applied Competency, MUS 4000 Capstone Recital) are required degree milestones and carry required_zero:true. The select-one major-ensemble slots (MUS 1571/MUS 1581/MUS 1681 lower level; MUS 3571/MUS 3581/MUS 3681 upper level) are seeded as single choice slots per catalog. Machine prereqs omitted (prereq: []) — the curriculum page prints no per-course prerequisites. tccns mirrors the local ATU course code; transfer_confidence core_only. Coordinator note (2026-10-01): allow_repeated_courses=true. The catalog genuinely requires the same courses in multiple semesters: MUS 1000/MUS 3000 Recital Attendance (0-credit, required each semester), a major ensemble each semester (footnote 9: only one ensemble credit per semester may count; select-one slots seeded as single choice slots with the catalog's slash notation, verbatim course codes preserved in options), and applied-music study each semester (MUS 1202 Piano / MUS 1232 Voice / MUS 1501 Band as applicable; instrument-specific numbers per catalog footnote 2). These are true repeats of the same requirement, not transcription errors.
